lines: Rahul Sharma, an individual selling shareholder, is due proceeds from selling 1,714,539 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of ₹25.89 crore are scheduled for listing on or about Friday, October 23, 2026, 23 days ago per the timetable.
Shares sold at the employee discount mean actual proceeds are slightly lower than the offer price implies.
Unknown: the pre-offer holding and average cost of acquisition, not confirmed from the documents.
